Sacrifice Art Sale Hosted by The Guild of Harwich Artists, Saturday, July 15, 9 – 1 pm, Harwich Community Center

Everything will be priced at $99 or less

Possible items include:
originals – framed or unframed
reproductions including: prints, cards, tiles, other 3-dimensional objects
photographs

art books
